about_the_game:
Dive into an epic Roguelite adventure wrapped in nostalgic pixel art, where every playthrough offers a fresh and thrilling experience. You play as a brave little slime, summoned by the legendary sorcerer Gandolf Gastor Griffin. Deep beneath his ancient castle lies a mysterious dungeon—once dormant, now rumbling with strange quakes and ancient magic. Your curiosity led you to venture deep into the depths to uncover what has awakened. 

A fully random and unique dungeon is generated for each playthrough—filled with secrets, powerful enemies, and lore-rich quests that uncover the lost history of this magical world. As you descend deeper, the foes become fiercer—but don’t worry! You’ll gain access to a wide array of weapons, abilities, and upgrades to help you overcome every challenge. 

Play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer mode to take down powerful dungeon bosses. 

Will you uncover the secrets that lie beneath Gandolf’s castle?
